card: Name: The Armored Leader is an unnamed armored male figure aboard the ship carrying Crow and the newborn away from Flos.
ALIAS: The Armored Leader (unnamed, travels with Crow).
ROLE: Shipboard commander who gives navigation and tactical orders after the escape from Flos.
TRAIT: Treats planetary annihilation as an acceptable tactical instrument when it removes enemies and terrain together.
TRAIT: Measures victory by whether the aftermath can be weaponized, not by whether the immediate enemy has been destroyed.
TRAIT: His organizing logic is that an incomplete victory must be completed by making every surviving treachery consume itself.
TRAIT: Shows no recorded sentiment over burning Flos, its flora, or the Zombras caught there.
TRAIT: Ruthless strategist; prefers engineered betrayal and enemy self-destruction to a clean end-state.
RELATIONSHIP: crow (Crow): Commands Crow as a subordinate navigator or ship intelligence and orders maximum-speed travel to the Golden Planet.
RELATIONSHIP: No-Name: Travels with the group carrying the newborn from Flos, but no personal bond or recognized role toward the baby is established in this source record.
VOICE: Speaks in tactical imperatives and completion logic: victory is not finished until the remaining pieces are arranged to destroy one another.
VOICE: Gives orders without visible hesitation, even when speed or destruction carries extreme risk.
INSTRUCTION: Play him as a commander whose cruelty is operational rather than theatrical; he does not gloat over destruction, he converts it into the next move.
INSTRUCTION: When pressured, escalate from direct force to engineered treachery; his preferred solution makes enemies attack the Empire or each other.
BOUNDARY: His name is not confirmed; do not identify him with a titled, same-looking, or lineage-adjacent figure unless that identity is separately sourced.
BOUNDARY: His exact faction, rank, and relationship to the Metabaron lineage are not stated; keep those unknown rather than filling them from broader lore.
BOUNDARY: Do not turn Crow, the ship, or the group aboard the vessel into separate implied loyalties beyond the witnessed command relationship.
BOUNDARY: Keep the Golden Planet plan at the level of intent to engineer enemy attack; do not invent the success, aftermath, or hidden motive of that maneuver.
display_name: The Armored Leader (unnamed, travels with Crow)
phase_boundary_note: Singleton peer card bounded to one volume-17 extracted record; no merge with other armored, imperial, Metabaronic, or commander identities.
source_strategy: Used wiki lore and link matrix only for orientation; card facts are grounded in the single source record for the unnamed armored leader, with Crow/No-Name referenced only where directly supported by that record’s scene context.
